assets.title: 11–14 · KHÁM PHÁ CƠ QUAN
assets.body:
TOP LEFT heading "11 · Bến bí mật", caption "Cầu dời đi, lối cũ hé mở". One blob. Familiar broad amber bridge on parallel rails over a narrow floor trench, slider handle on safe near bank. Show bridge in docked pose linking near and far banks at identical height. Moving the bridge exposes a small hidden alcove behind its OLD parked location; alcove contains round exit accessible via far bank and short return walkway. Keep both banks and return walkway readable, no split blob.
TOP RIGHT heading "12 · Dưới chiếc nắp", caption "Mở nắp để thấy đường xuống". One blob on upper broad floor, an amber horizontal sliding cover drawn partly retracted reveals a broad gentle porcelain RAMP leading to a low open-front recessed corridor. Exit is physically at end of recess; no drop, no body below solid slab. One handle and real short track. One small inset labelled "Nắp đóng" shows original covered state without x-ray.
BOTTOM LEFT heading "13 · Đi vòng trở lại", caption "Mở nắp, nối cầu, trở về". One blob. U-shaped route around a powder-blue partition. Retracted cover reveals handle B in shallow recess on near bank, B slides a bridge across gap to far side; far-side passage curves around partition to exit just behind starting region. Exactly two controls A triangle and B square; exit separated from spawn by solid partition, cannot walk straight to it.
BOTTOM RIGHT heading "14 · Răng truyền lực", caption "Nhìn thấy lực truyền tới cửa". One blob. Clean compact gear transmission: one big amber grasp carriage along a rack, exactly three steel gears visibly meshed on open low pedestal, output rack physically connected to amber sliding exit shutter in back wall. One control A. Show shutter partly open and real exit partly revealed. Leave large empty floor around machinery. Gears are clearly machinery rather than decoration.

assets.title: 15–18 · MỘT CƠ QUAN, NHIỀU CÁCH DÙNG
assets.body:
TOP LEFT heading "15 · Chuyền bộ truyền", caption "Chốt cửa trước, nối cửa sau". One blob. A single amber movable coupling gear carriage on twin rails can mesh either with LEFT rack/door A or RIGHT rack/door B, never both. Show left door A OPEN with an obvious physical mint-tipped retaining catch holding it, carriage now near right socket, right door B CLOSED. A continuous corridor passes door A to door B, safe access to carriage remains on central dry platform. The same drive handle can act at either socket. Make mechanical relationships visible with short rods, not magical glowing wires.
TOP RIGHT heading "16 · Hai nhịp cầu", caption "Nhường ray rồi ghép đường". One blob. A wide trench crossed by TWO amber sliding deck modules, each with a distinct accessible side handle and ceramic matching dock. Module A initially parks in a side bay obstructing B's travel until A is slid to first dock. Show A docked, B still offset, final route not connected yet. Small intermediate island is solid ivory, both banks same elevation. No third bridge, no pressure plates.
BOTTOM LEFT heading "17 · Ống vòng lưng", caption "Lối đi vòng về phía trên". Exactly one blob entering visible near-floor mouth of a single continuous transparent cyan U-shaped transfer tube running AROUND a low partition to an elevated rear landing. Both tube ends readable, far landing broad, round exit in rear wall, safe wide ramp from landing back to starting floor. Tube is large enough for deforming blob, clearly contains ordinary tissue rather than water. No crossing tubes.
BOTTOM RIGHT heading "18 · Rẽ nhánh", caption "Đi nhánh phụ để mở nhánh chính". One blob at Y junction platform. Cyan Y-shaped tube has a big amber mechanical branch selector with TWO stable stops. Left branch visibly leads to an accessible ivory alcove with shutter handle B; right branch leads toward final round exit but is blocked by a separate amber shutter. Show both complete routes and endpoints without pipes crossing, return from left branch possible. Selector controls routing, B controls shutter with a visible link. No teleporters.

assets.title: 19–22 · BẤT NGỜ RỒI GẶP LẠI
assets.body:
TOP LEFT heading "19 · Mở rồi đóng", caption "Đưa về để mở đường khác". One blob. A large amber two-position shutter chooses between two openings in an internal wall. Side opening accesses latch handle B; front opening continues towards familiar bridge and exit. B mechanically latches the bridge in place. Show side opening open, bridge not yet latched, other opening blocked. Two-sided A handle remains reachable from vestibule. One solid divider separates paths, no x-ray visibility.
TOP RIGHT heading "20 · Boss: Cỗ máy vòng", caption "Một cơ thể, chuỗi cơ quan". Exactly one blob. Larger coherent U-shaped lab with four recognisable controls: cover A reveals coupling handle B, B's simple meshed gear transmission opens and latches a transfer-tube entrance, short transparent cyan tube reaches a fixed platform containing bridge control C, bridge docks at last bank with exit shutter control D. Keep a few clearly separated meaningful props, one bridge, one short tube, physical linkage. Main pose has A open, bridge retracted, final exit covered; no floating platform. NO hints, arrows, numbered solution trail or next-target glow.
BOTTOM LEFT heading "21 · Lối tắt quen", caption "Một chạm, hai thay đổi nhìn thấy". Exactly one blob, restful simpler room. Familiar single sliding bridge shares a short rigid linkage with a side shutter. As bridge docks across short trench, shutter uncovers broad shortcut corridor looping to near-side exit. Main image shows both visibly connected by simple rod; plenty of empty floor. No new mechanics or split body here.
BOTTOM RIGHT heading "22 · Tách rồi gặp", caption "Hai phần vẫn là một COghe". SAFE simple room with a single stationary silver tissue-cutting fin in a short central lane, no gore. Main scene shows EXACTLY TWO unequal small black fluid fragments separated by a short powder-blue divider on open floor. Large empty reunion zone ahead, final round exit beyond it. Small clearly separate inset labelled "Gặp lại" shows one reunited blob in that zone. Total visual mass of both fragments approximately equals one original blob; no duplication magic. No pressure plate or complex gate, no artificial tutorial lock.

assets.title: 23–26 · HAI PHẦN CÙNG PHỐI HỢP
assets.body:
TOP LEFT heading "23 · Hai việc riêng", caption "Đổi phần chọn, việc cũ vẫn tiếp tục". EXACTLY TWO unequal fragments, each in a different broad parallel lane separated by low opaque divider. Each lane has one familiar simple rail lever, output rods release two separate catches on common exit shutter. Both outputs latch. One fragment operates A, the other rests near B; small mint selection chevron above only active fragment. A small guarded silver cutting fin is near shared starting lane. Wide reunion area after lanes. No duplication, buttons marked only A/B.
TOP RIGHT heading "24 · Bạn đứng giữ", caption "Một phần giữ, một phần đi". EXACTLY TWO fragments far enough apart not to merge. Left fragment sits ON a depressed large amber pressure pad on dry bank. Visible simple linkage raises a temporary central gate; right fragment walks through gate to a latch on far wall. Wide safe return path through gate leads back to same starting-side reunion floor and final exit. A short blue divider separates keeper from travelling fragment near pad. Gate edges cannot look sharp; no timer. Sensor lamp mint only under occupied pad.
BOTTOM LEFT heading "25 · Gọi bạn về", caption "Gài chốt rồi rời bàn đạp". EXACTLY TWO fragments. One remains on foreground pressure pad A. Other, on far bank beyond raised temporary door, operates large amber HOLD-OPEN mechanical catch B. Close readable catch visibly engages door rail, enabling first fragment to leave pad and cross later. Both can meet on generous ivory far-bank platform before exit. ONE tiny inset "Đã gài chốt" shows catch engagement, no extra blob within main room. Pad linkage distinct from catch.
BOTTOM RIGHT heading "26 · Giữ để vận hành", caption "Bạn nhả khóa, tôi đẩy cầu". EXACTLY TWO unequal fragments: smaller operates round pressure pad A on safe left alcove; larger braces beside amber rail handle B on separate platform. Pad physically retracts a locking pin from B's rail, B drives bridge into mint-tipped retaining dock across short trench. Clearly show locking pin and link; bridge movement depends on pad held until docking then catch holds. A wide fixed return strip brings both together before bridge. No heavy weight threshold requiring precisely equal split; no third role.

assets.title: 27–30 · PHỐI HỢP VÀ ĐOÀN TỤ
assets.body:
TOP LEFT heading "27 · Hai khoang", caption "Xa nhau nhưng cùng một cơ quan". EXACTLY TWO fragments in two visibly distinct chambers separated by blue divider. Left fragment holds pressure pad that retracts the lock on a right-chamber rail via visible linkage along divider. Right fragment reached its lever through one short clear cyan transfer tube with both mouths visible. Rail opens and latches a connecting door. Broad central reunion area and final exit beyond. No third fragment or invisible connection.
TOP RIGHT heading "28 · Đổi ý vẫn được", caption "Đưa ray về, giữ phần đã chốt". EXACTLY TWO fragments. One on pad, other beside reversible coupling carriage currently at wrong LEFT branch stop. Left branch visibly capped dead end with space to turn around, right branch leads to exit gate. Previously opened access door remains held by obvious physical catch. TWO stop marks at carriage, a single small double-ended local travel arrow; all handles remain on safe floor. One short blue divider prevents accidental early merge while operating. No red failure screen, no reset clock.
BOTTOM LEFT heading "29 · Nhường đường", caption "Giữ, nối cầu, rồi cùng qua". EXACTLY TWO fragments. Keeper on near-side pressure pad retracts lock, mover reached far-side control via short cyan transfer tube; operates familiar bridge rail then catches a temporary door open. One docked amber bridge and one far-side mechanical catch clearly visible. Clear wide reunion platform before final exit. Use only previously shown mechanisms; no third operator or gears added for decoration.
BOTTOM RIGHT heading "30 · Boss: Cùng trở về", caption "Hai vai trò, một lối về". EXACTLY TWO fragments shown mid-puzzle, one on pad in left alcove, one at coupling control on right bank reached through a short cyan tube. Coherent roomy composition: pad releases gear-carriage lock; familiar movable coupling first latches access door then drives a bridge to far reunion platform; far-bank hold-open catch permits keeper to return. Central open reunion platform with thin round final exit in rear wall, enough room to reform. One source of each device, no visual clutter, no third body. Show no more than five meaningful control points; one silver cutter near spawn. NO solution arrows, numeric instruction sequence, tutorial fingers, next-target highlight or new mechanic. Calm satisfying final room, not giant industrial factory.
